name: Set types — subtypes of a card type the object still has are kept (CR 205.1a)
notes: The set-types branch of applyEffect wiped every subtype. Darksteel Mutation ('is an Insect artifact creature … loses all other card types and creature types') on an Equipment creature swaps the creature types only: Equipment is an artifact type and the object is still an artifact. On a plain creature the result is still just Insect.
